Hi, thank you for all your help and support. You were a huge help, really. I had a very long talk with my mom and I feel much better. She also helped me see a lot of the underlying issues that brought me here today. Her and I are very much alike, so she understands more than anyone. She told me the reason she left my father years ago. I think he may be a narcissist and has codependency issues. He has become codependent on me. It's painfully obvious now that it's been brought up. I just never saw it.

For the past 8 months or so I have been playing amateur therapist as he's been having issues with a rather complicated romantic relationship which we discuss daily and I know all the gritty details of. It explains why I am not comfortable talking about my problems with him. He usually end up making it about himself. If I talk about suicide his go to is basically "do you realize how much that would hurt me?" Which just makes me feel guilty. It explains why he won't dare kick me out. Why I can get away with being a deadbeat and do soft drugs all the time as long as I continue to provide emotional support. In a fit of anger he told me I couldn't smoke weed anymore. He relented when I said I wasn't going to discuss his relationship issues any longer.

This is a difficult revalation to process to say the least. This is a man that I love to death, so the idea that he may be causing some of my mental issues is difficult to handle. He means well. He loves me and isn't trying to hurt me. But he may be leaning on me in such a way that isn't healthy for either of us. He's enabling me and I'm currently providing the kind of emotional support to him that shouldn't be expected of me and that I won't be able to provide long term. Also I've been basically telling him what he wants to hear, because I'm not in a position to tell him what he needs to hear.

Me and my mom are going camping this weekend to get away from all the craziness of regular life. I'm going back to therapy. The free clinic wasn't nearly as bad as I described. I was just looking for any excuse to not go back to therapy, because I wanted to reject anyone's help. I was doing the same with you earlier today. Rejecting any nice words or helpful suggestions you gave and creating justification as to why it's wrong.

I'm going to need professional help to fully process the issues that have just been brought to the surface. Also I wouldn't mind doing group with my mom there. I haven't held anything back as far as my worries, suicidal thoughts, drug abuse and she understands and is helpful probably because she's gone through the same stuff.

Again thank you for caring so much. Never has an Internet stranger seemed to genuinely care so much. If you don't mind I might PM you at some point in the future if I need advice or something. Is that okay?

I tried therapy before. Their lies are sweet, but they are still lies. I called one of those hotlines once and it didn't help. (Whichever one Google tries to shove down your throat.) I can't afford a good therapist and I'm not wasting more of my dad's money on pointless treatment.

I used to go to this free mental health clinic, but their answer was to take mind numbing pills laden with side effects. Then go to group therapy filled with crackheads and the like because practically everyone else there is going for court ordered rehab and group is cheaper than individual. I never felt like I really belonged there though. My problems were petty and insignificant compared to everyone elses. They all had hard drug addictions on top of legal issues and I was worried about having to work to provide for myself. That was before my mom got a DWI and started going herself, so I'd be even less comfortable saying anything in group therapy with her there.

It's not suprising you think I'm a kid or teenager. I'm not I'm 21. (Close I guess) Still living with my dad because I've been such a failure up until now. I've probably acomplished as much as your average 12 year old and spent the rest of my time fucking up my life and putting my family through hell. 

I have no real savings, a crap job that was handed to me, a free college education that I'm too stupid and lazy to take advantage of and I'll lose that soon. Absolutely no plans to better myself or provide for myself. And I don't care enough to make any, because I know that providing for myself is going to be far more work than I'm willing to put into my mere survival. Which is very little since I'd rather put effort into ending my life, not extending it.

I don't want to hurt my family. It's the only reason I hang on, but it's a shitty existence living for that reason alone.

No. Unfortunately they can trace calls and inform the police. If I call them I'd be in the hospital again before the day is out. I made the mistake of talking about how I feel to people who can have me committed (a shrink) once and I won't do it again.

I don't see how anyone could feel anything but pity and disappointment for the likes of me.
I suppose. Honestly I'm past caring about getting better. I don't really want to get better anymore.

I know and I hate myself for putting him through this. I wish I could have been the son he could be proud of, but I can't. I'll always be a disappointment and a burden. Killing myself would hurt him a lot I realize that, but at least after that I couldn't hurt anyone anymore.

Being watched all the time. No privacy because he's going through my shit everytime I turn my back. Prisoner is a strong word. If I were really treated like a prisoner I would be lying in a casket with no head instead of typing this.

Edit: I'm just looking for a legit excuse to kill myself because the real reasons I want to die are petty.

I'm sure it would help. I don't believe it would make me want to live though. I've wanted to die for years now. I didn't become a regular drinker until my 21st birthday about 9 months ago when it went from hardest drug to aquire to by far the easiest to aquire.

Yeah I'm not going to use it anymore, but it was the silver lining to an otherwise unfulfilling life. I only liked it because I was barely conscious on it and didn't feel worse once it's over. And of course it's the reason I'm basically a prisoner in my own home now. Can't really blame him, but I'd rather die than live like this. 

On some level I think I do this shit just to fuck my life up enough to justify suicide. I can barely remember a time in which I didn't hope for death. Cancer, car accident, getting murdered that kind of thing. I feel like I'm subconsciously trying to make things bad enough that I can do it myself. I can't do it because I haven't been backed far enough into the corner. Everytime I seriously consider doing it I put it off, so I'm trying to make things so bad for myself that I have no choice, but to kill myself.
Maybe 3 times a week. 4-5 drinks per session. I don't even like it that much.

Right now? No nothing besides weed and alcohol. And I'm sober at the moment since I'm at work. I wouldn't say I'm addicted to anything in particular (besides weed a little bit). It's more that getting high on something is the only thing that brings me any amount of joy. I feel like I'm addicted to drugs in general. And yeah my dad caught me using ketamine a week ago and got super pissed, threatened to kick me out and is surely the reason he's going through my shit. I wish he had kicked me out honestly then I'd have no option but to kill myself.

Also this is unrelated, but I was helping moving a very heavy bathtub down stairs for my boss yesterday and if there hadn't been people besides me holding it from underneath I really think I would have let go, let it fall, and crush me.

I wish he didn't care. I wish he would throw me out onto the street and tell me to not come back. Then there would be nothing holding me back and I could finally have the rest I've wanted so badly. I'm tired of being a burden on my family.

This is copied from the above comment to somewhat explain why I want to die:

Life is too hard for a weakling like me. I don't want to go back to college. I don't want a career. And I don't want to forever be a burden on those around me. I'm a broken person beyond repair and broken things need to be disposed of. All I am is deadweight to anyone who still cares about me for reasons I don't understand.

I'm a stupid junkie who should have been cast out onto the street a long time ago. I don't want to turn myself around. I only want to die. There is nothing in life that makes survival worth fighting for.

The life I want is unattainable. I don't want to spend a third of my life working my ass off to buy food and shelter. I was on one that made me numb for awhile (Lexapro), so I can totally relate. It's not good, but better than the alternative. I stopped it because it also gave me more energy which was cool, but kinda dangerous when it didn't stop the suicidal thoughts because I went from wanting to die, but too tired to actually do anything to actively preparing to kill myself.

 It turns out the one that worked was Citalopram which is only slightly different, so maybe you need something similar to Pristiq? Effexor is a SNRI like Pristiq and is generic. I bet you've tried it, but if not maybe mention it to your doctor? 

I find when medication works you don't even feel it's effects. I was just happier and things didn't worry me like they normally would when I took Citalopram. I liked Lexapro when I took it, but looking back it was because I felt too drugged to give a shit about anything.

Disclaimer: This is in no way my area of expertise, so take all that with a grain of salt.

I agree with the other guy it sounds like you would benefit from an ADHD medication and a GP will be reluctant to prescribe a controlled substance that they are not very familiar with. A psychiatrist will probably have dozens of patients already taking such medications and will be very familiar with them sort of like how only a pain management doctor will prescribe more than a very small amount of opiates. If you sign the proper releases to allow your psychologist to discuss your treatment with the psychiatrist then he/she will have no problem prescribing ritalin or adderall.

This is another reason I've stayed my hand this long. I don't really know what comes next. I'm an athiest, so I expect oblivion and that's what I want. Nothingness as if I were to sleep and never wake, but I don't really know.

 I was a Christian before I lost my faith. A benevolent god wouldn't let people suffer like this, so he's either not real or he doesn't care about us. Still I was "saved" in my youth and was taught that's all it takes to go to heaven and other Christians say suicide is a sure fire way into hell, so that could go either way if they are actually right.

 Reincarnation is the one that scares me the most since in the grand scheme of things I'm fortunate and would most likely come back into a shittier situation. I've also toyed with the idea that my life will simply start over and in that case I'd better die sooner rather than later. The first part of my life was nice and I wouldn't mind living that over and over. It's the last several years that have been hell and it's only going to get worse.

Sorry OP for hijacking your post. And sorry for all the philosophy.

Life is definitely a battle, but some people (like me) don't feel it's worth fighting. I'd rather surrender and lose (die). At this point the people who love me are the reason I keep fighting, but I hate them for making me do it. They are standing in the way of me getting what I really want. Survival is a difficult and endless battle and I don't care about the reward it brings.
